title: Daande Jaliinde Yaakaare
intro: Naatde e galle ɗo majjugol rewi e majjugol, kono daande wootere deeƴnde ina salii jikke. Noddaango wooto e nder Quraan ina wayla muñal e mbaydi mbaylaandi; mbele aɗa waawi rewindaade nate neɗɗo gonɗo caggal oon daande?
clues: Miin ko mi daande muñal nder galle ɗo barkeeji jarribortee e musiiba.
Mi heddii e galle mo ŋakkere jawdi e sukaaɓe ŋakkiraa.
Miɗo anndi ñawu nguu kadi yanii e oon sehil, mo ɓanndu mum tampi.
Nde bone ɓeydii heewde, mi noddii e siimtinde Alla.
Mi sakkitii bayyinaango wooto: Alla ko Goonga, ɗum noon muñan.
Mi noddii Ayyuuba e innde; caggal ɗuum Alla itti bone ɗee, artiri ɓesngu nguu.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Heddoraade e Ayyuuba rewrude e majjude e ñawu, caggal ɗuum noddude muñal
Jeertinde nulaaɗo peewɗo yoo woppu renndo bonngo
trial.answer: Heddoraade e Ayyuuba rewrude e majjude e ñawu, caggal ɗuum noddude muñal

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Bayyinaango wonde Alla ko Goonga e muñal ina ɗaɓɓi
Noddaango ngam mahde laana woɗɗuka e ɓuuɓol
Koyngal koode sappo e goo e naange fuɗnge
location.answer: Bayyinaango wonde Alla ko Goonga e muñal ina ɗaɓɓi

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Torra Ayyuuba ittaa, ɓesngu mum artiraa
Cukalel ngel ɓooyi ɗaminaade rokkaama caggal juulde ɓuuɓnde
Laamɗo suka gooto firti duuɓi jeeɗiɗi keewɗi e ŋakkeende
Cukalel halfinaaɗo hisnaama e ndiyam ɓuuɓɗam
outcome.answer: Torra Ayyuuba ittaa, ɓesngu mum artiraa

verse: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire. (83:16)
